column1: # RSpace receive-first paired-PathMap query product: mutable read zippers versus per-byte borrowed TrieRef focuses.

# Fixture: actual RhoPathV1 relative datum keys with a shared prefix; the first structural frame is wildcarded, the exact second frame selects one unique candidate, and the identity subtree is [0,0]. Exact sorted candidate vectors are compared before timing.

# Criterion: one valid preregistered run, 82 regression samples per arm and cardinality, three explicit checked warm-ups per arm, 2 s Criterion warm-up, 5 s requested measurement interval, 99% confidence, 1% significance.

# Primary decision (pgmcp experiment/hypothesis 220, cardinality 256): REJECTED. Treatment mean regressed 61.953121%; Welch t=1355.572301467 for the locked treatment<control alternative, p=1, Cohen's d=211.704825832, mean-difference 95% CI [44032.238680374,44160.731274178] ns. Both arms departed from normality; robustness Cliff's delta=1 and Mann-Whitney p rounded to zero.

# Engineering interpretation: per-byte TrieRef descent repeatedly rebuilds/copies in-node focus-key state; the paired mutable read zippers advance and ascend in place. Treatment also regressed 83.041035% at cardinality 16 and 55.549314% at 4096. Production therefore retains paired mutable read zippers.
